implementation_summary: Implemented and independently reviewed the CGO-free SQLite migration runner, transactional repositories, deduplication/provenance, retained-history source deletion, feed primitives, and sanitized failure mapping.

files_changed.change: Added store lifecycle, exact migrations, transactions, and authoritative MVP repositories.
Added feed-filter persistence and durable source observation identity contracts.
Added forward-only source tombstone and external-ID alias migrations.
Added migration, repository, concurrency, dedup, provenance, retention, restart, error, and secret-boundary integration tests.
Pinned the BSD-3-Clause pure-Go modernc SQLite driver for CGO-free Windows support.

verification.output: Focused persistence suite passed under the race detector.
Full suite passed with migrations=3, strict history, indexed plans, and secrets absent.
All packages built for Windows amd64 without CGO.
Modules verified and diff is clean.

proof.summary: Tests enforce identity merging through canonical URL, fingerprint, and every external alias without content/topic/provenance loss.
Source tombstones retain article/library history; feed optional-state and failure semantics, locks, cancellation, rollback, restart, and migration prefix are enforced.
Independent reviewer approved revision 13ee7ad8de2ecb9c488bbc0be171246e681ca653 after two correction rounds.

notes: go.mod/go.sum are a necessary reviewed exception to the task area list; modernc.org/sqlite v1.38.2 is pinned, CGO-free, BSD-3-Clause, and passed module/Windows review.
